# Delphic Observatory

> A read-only, provenance-aware research and engineering observatory for timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo. GitHub holds canonical source, lane definitions, issues, pull requests and workflow evidence.

## Core pages
- [Observatory control room](https://delphic-observatory-timerloggedout-5184s-projects.vercel.app/): live public repository feeds and research lane matrix.
- [Observatory Markdown mirror](https://delphic-observatory-timerloggedout-5184s-projects.vercel.app/index.md): text-first page mirror.
- [Research lane architecture](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo/blob/master/docs/research/LANE-ARCHITECTURE.md): canonical lane families and evidence-flow contract.
- [DO + Siglary mandate](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo/blob/master/docs/ops/DO-STATEMENT-SIGLARY-MANDATE.md): communication and contribution standard.
- [Free-tier + credit policy](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo/blob/master/docs/ops/FREE-TIER-AND-CREDIT-POLICY.md): procurement and service-cost gates.
- [Platform migration](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo/blob/master/docs/ops/DELPHIC-OBSERVATORY-PLATFORM-MIGRATION.md): GitHub, Vercel and Render ownership.
- [Delphic / DoE integration](https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo/blob/master/docs/ops/DELPHIC-DOE-MONEYBALL-INTEGRATION.md): configured-instance candidate and governance contract.
